{"content":[{"type":"text","text":"Fine-knit crew-neck sweater, slightly relaxed fit, hip length, cream #F1E7D3, merino wool
Straight-leg trousers, mid-rise, ankle length so the hems stay dry, deep olive #4E5A3C, wool-blend crepe
Belted trench coat, single-breasted, knee length, with a storm flap and a hood, warm sand #B79B72, water-repellent cotton gabardine
Ankle boots, almond toe, low block heel, rubber grip sole, chocolate brown #5B3F2F, suede with a waterproofing treatment
Compact structured tote bag, medium size, cognac #9A5B34, water-resistant grained leather
Large umbrella, automatic, dark forest green #2F3E32, windproof polyester
Silk-blend scarf, loosely knotted, soft sage #A9B8A0, matte twill

This outfit suits a neat office day. The sweater and tailored trousers look polished, and the ankle-length hem keeps the suede boots out of the puddles on the walk. The warm cream, olive and sand tones flatter her golden hair, warm skin and grey-green eyes. The trench coat and umbrella cover the all-day rain, and the sage scarf echoes her eye color.
